scripts.prepare: if [ -n "$CI" ]; then exit 0; fi; command -v pre-commit >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: pre-commit is not installed. Install it (brew install pre-commit | pipx install pre-commit) and re-run yarn install.'; exit 1; }; pre-commit install
scripts.coverage: forge coverage --no-match-coverage 'test|^script/' --no-match-test '_pinnedBytecode' > temp-coverage.out 2>&1; status=$?; cat temp-coverage.out; if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then exit $status; fi; node script/coverage/checkCoverage.js temp-coverage.out && rm temp-coverage.out
